changes.title: Letter impact
items: An animal you win over celebrates for a second, its own way: hoppers jump and spin, four-legged ones roll over, flyers loop the loop and the rest do a wiggle-dance, with a burst of hearts, and its sigil above the runestone turns to your colour with a pop

A 💌 landing on an animal now lands with a punch: a white flash, a little squash, its ring slot popping in and a soft thunk that rises as the ring fills; the 💌 that fills the ring holds the picture for an instant
With Reduce flashing on there is no white flash and the squash is gentler

changes.title: Messenger
items: A new bag to find: the Messenger, whose letters hop on from one creature to the next nearby, up to three

changes.title: Clutch
items: A new bag to find: the Clutch, whose far, fast letters pass through up to three creatures in a line
